research_assessment.outcome: Closest to case A: Full-History has lower normalized endpoint observation error at every evaluated horizon and slower absolute error growth; compounding error still remains.
research_assessment.history_vs_no_memory_50_steps: 63.09748% normalized RMSE reduction; advantage also holds on the identical 26122-window cohort.
research_assessment.pi_state_reference: Intermediate overall performance and slightly better vertical velocity error at long horizons; teacher-forced PI input does not make this a full physical-state oracle.
research_assessment.latent_interpretation: Prediction error is accompanied by growing latent drift, with bounded norms; this is descriptive, not a causal attribution to PI state.
research_assessment.next_recommendation: Separately authorized multi-step dynamics training is worth studying; no training or next-stage work performed.

limitations: Nominal simulation, one dataset and training seed, maximum prediction horizon 2 seconds.
Overlapping Test windows are correlated; horizon-specific cohorts differ, with a common-max-horizon cohort reported separately.
Fixed recorded future actions, not a closed-loop policy rollout or planning evaluation.
PI-State Baseline uses teacher-forced future PI state, not complete physical state or autonomous hidden-state prediction.
50-step distance<0.1m group contains only 80 eligible windows.
No model retraining, new noise, dynamics randomization, latent physical interpretation or control guarantee.
